snippet.title: Animal Crossing: City Folk Deluxe | Release Trailer
snippet.description:
https://aurumsmods.com/accfdeluxe/
Animal Crossing: City Folk Deluxe is an unofficial enhancement patch for Animal Crossing: City Folk / Let's Go to the City that introduces new content and gameplay changes. It can be played on any homebrew-enabled Wii or Wii U via Riivolution; no backup images or hardware mods needed. Online play is mostly supported thanks to the services of Wiimmfi and WiiLink.
Huge thanks to @Reveriemasters and @SY24_ for creating this awesome trailer!
